import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 24
P = 16
HID = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.register_buffer("pos", torch.eye(self.Z).reshape(1, self.Z, self.Z, 1, 1))
        cin = 12 + 3 + self.Z
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(cin, W, 1)
        self.zmix = nn.Conv2d(3 * W, W, 1)
        self.glob1 = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, P, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(P, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.g = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Z = self.Z
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        per = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X).transpose(1, 2)
        zero = torch.zeros_like(per[:, :1])
        below = torch.cat([zero, per[:, :-1]], 1)
        above = torch.cat([per[:, 1:], zero], 1)
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        pos = self.pos.expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([per, below, above, gl, pos], 2).reshape(B * Z, -1, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.inp(x))
        h5 = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        up = torch.cummax(h5, 1).values
        dn = torch.cummax(h5.flip(1), 1).values.flip(1)
        h = F.relu(self.zmix(torch.cat([h5, up, dn], 2).reshape(B * Z, 3 * W, Y, X)))
        h5 = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        pooled = torch.cat([h5.mean((1, 3, 4)), h5.amax((1, 3, 4))], 1)
        h5 = F.relu(h5 + self.glob1(pooled)[:, None, :, None, None])
        h = h5.reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(h + self.c3(h))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            hh = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(hh))
        s = torch.cat(res, 1).reshape(B, Z, self.T, Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, 1).flatten(1)
        h5 = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        g = self.g(torch.cat([h5.mean((1, 3, 4)), h5.amax((1, 3, 4))], 1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.0015, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 32
HID = 64
RED = 8


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(F.relu(self.c1(x))))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.kh = max(int(a) for a, b in spec.footprints)
        self.kw = max(int(b) for a, b in spec.footprints)
        cin = spec.in_channels + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.b1 = Block(W)
        self.glob1 = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.b2 = Block(W)
        self.foot = nn.Conv2d(W, W, (self.kh, self.kw))
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(W, self.T, 1)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(W, RED, 1)
        self.flat = nn.Linear(RED * self.Y * self.X, self.n_place)
        self.g = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        x = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)
        h = self.stem(x)
        h = self.b1(h)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        h = F.relu(h + self.glob1(pooled)[:, :, None, None])
        h = self.b2(h)
        q = F.pad(h, (0, self.kw - 1, 0, self.kh - 1))
        p = F.relu(self.foot(q))
        place = self.out(p).flatten(1)
        z = F.relu(self.red(h)).flatten(1)
        place = place + self.flat(z)
        g = self.g(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.0015, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 32
RED = 16
HID = 256


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(F.relu(self.c1(x))))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_act = int(spec.n_actions)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.b1 = Block(W)
        self.glob1 = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.b2 = Block(W)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(W, RED, 1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(RED * self.Y * self.X, HID)
        self.mfc = nn.Linear(self.n_act, HID)
        self.pi = nn.Linear(HID, self.n_act)
        self.value = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        h = self.stem(obs)
        h = self.b1(h)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        h = F.relu(h + self.glob1(pooled)[:, :, None, None])
        h = self.b2(h)
        z = F.relu(self.red(h)).flatten(1)
        g = F.relu(self.fc(z) + self.mfc(mask.to(obs.dtype)))
        return self.pi(g), self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.002}

W = 32
HID = 64


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(F.relu(self.c1(x))))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.kh = max(int(a) for a, b in spec.footprints)
        self.kw = max(int(b) for a, b in spec.footprints)
        cin = spec.in_channels + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.b1 = Block(W)
        self.glob1 = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.b2 = Block(W)
        self.foot = nn.Conv2d(W, W, (self.kh, self.kw))
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(W, self.T, 1)
        self.g = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        x = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)
        h = self.stem(x)
        h = self.b1(h)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        h = F.relu(h + self.glob1(pooled)[:, :, None, None])
        h = self.b2(h)
        q = F.pad(h, (0, self.kw - 1, 0, self.kh - 1))
        p = F.relu(self.foot(q))
        place = self.out(p).flatten(1)
        g = self.g(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.0015, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 32
P = 32
H = 32
HID = 64


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(F.relu(self.c1(x))))


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = spec.in_channels + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.b1 = Block(W)
        self.glob1 = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.b2 = Block(W)
        self.head = PoolHead(W, spec.footprints, P, H)
        self.g = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        x = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)
        h = self.stem(x)
        h = self.b1(h)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        h = F.relu(h + self.glob1(pooled)[:, :, None, None])
        h = self.b2(h)
        place = self.head(h)
        g = self.g(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9, "lr": 0.0007, "ent_coef": 0.005}

D = 48
FF = 96
HEADS = 4
LAYERS = 2
HID = 64


class Layer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, ff, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(d, ff)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(ff, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, d = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).reshape(B, N, 3, self.h, d // self.h).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        x = x + self.o(a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, d))
        x = x + self.f2(F.relu(self.f1(self.n2(x))))
        return x


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.kh = max(int(a) for a, b in spec.footprints)
        self.kw = max(int(b) for a, b in spec.footprints)
        cin = spec.in_channels + self.T
        self.embed = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, D, 1))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, D, self.Y, self.X))
        nn.init.trunc_normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([Layer(D, FF, HEADS) for _ in range(LAYERS)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.foot = nn.Conv2d(D, 32, (self.kh, self.kw))
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(32, self.T, 1)
        self.g = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value = nn.Linear(HID, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, Y, X).to(obs.dtype)
        x = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)
        h = self.embed(x) + self.pos
        t = h.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        for layer in self.layers:
            t = layer(t)
        t = self.nf(t)
        h = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        q = F.pad(h, (0, self.kw - 1, 0, self.kh - 1))
        p = F.relu(self.foot(q))
        place = self.out(p).flatten(1)
        g = self.g(torch.cat([t.mean(1), t.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 dev success on both seeds, so dev success can't rank anything at this point. Mean training success and the training signals will have to rank round 1. The starting net trains on about 131k steps at 4 PPO epochs. Its first spatial convolution comes only after two 1×1 layers, and it never sees the action mask. Following the suggested split, round 1 separates two effects: (a) a recipe-only change (2 epochs, which gives about 1.85× more samples, plus a longer horizon with gamma 0.98 and lambda 0.95) on the starting net; (b) a new residual 2D CNN with heights as channels, global context fed back into the cells, a footprint-aligned per-cell head and the action mask as an input, using the default recipe; and (c) both together. The new net is kept at or below the starting net's FLOPs, so r = 1 and no samples are lost. If all three stay at 0 dev success, compare mean training success to decide whether the problem is learning or generalisation.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials, and the starting net, scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success in the last 10% of training. None failed or came near the time limit (about 40–50 s each). The problem is learning itself, so dev success cannot rank anything yet. Neither two PPO epochs nor the residual 3×3 CNN produced a single exact build. A network smaller than the starting one gets no extra samples, because r below 1 counts as 1. The hard part is probably working out each brick's landing layer: the highest filled cell under its footprint. The task also needs a check that every cell the brick fills is still missing and that the brick seals no missing cells beneath it. So the nets so far need a strong per-layer bias. This round tests: (a) a 1-epoch recipe on the round-1 residual CNN, giving about 3.3× the starting sample count; (b) a net that reads each height layer as a token, run with the 2-epoch recipe; and (c) the same layer-token net with the 1-epoch recipe.
analyses.3: All six trials score 0 on dev and 0 on training success. The failures are no-learning, not timeouts or check failures, so the problem is learning itself. More samples (1 epoch, about 426k steps), longer gamma, a residual CNN and a per-layer token net all failed to move training success. Training with shaped per-cell reward over 426k samples should give at least some small successes on 6-drop designs, so complete failure is suspicious. Every head so far assumes the described action layout, with per-cell, translation-equivariant logits that are aligned to spec.footprints. The task warns the world may differ. If the action indexing differs (for example transposed axes, a different anchor, or swapped types), every conv head would map features to the wrong cells and learning would stall, which matches what we see. This round: (1) a hybrid conv-plus-flat head, (2) a purely flat head that does not depend on the layout, and (3) a test of the untested entropy axis, in case 0.01 entropy over about 200 actions stops the policy from sharpening.
analyses.4: Nine trials, two seeds each, all scored 0 on both dev success and training success. None failed a check or timed out, and all ran in 38–260 s. Neither recipe change (2 or 1 epochs giving up to 426k samples, gamma 0.98, lower entropy) nor architecture change (ResCNN, layer-token net, flat and hybrid heads) moved training success off 0. So the bottleneck is learning itself, not generalisation. The flat-head diagnostic also stayed at 0. That makes a mismatched action layout an unlikely sole cause, but it does not rule one out. With no positive signal there is nothing to refine, and the starting architecture stays selected unless a candidate scores above 0. In this last round I try three untested directions: (1) the ResCNN trunk with the starting net's footprint max/min/avg pooling head, which suits landing-layer reasoning; (2) a recipe with a short horizon and episode-length rollouts; (3) global self-attention over cells.
